AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.title: Gray Arcology Metallurgist
AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.description: Before joining the Colonial Advance Team, {PAWN_nameDef} worked as a metallurgist on an ecumenopolis. She was obsessed with the molten metal spraying from smelting crucibles—those visions of liquid light boiling into fireworks in the air enthralled her. For nearly a decade, she hardly realized she was single-handedly overseeing the operation of an entire alloy plant.\n But this obsession never receded; her willingness to engage with others faded like white smoke after spent fireworks.

AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.title: Gray Marine
AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.description: The mortar of war ground {PAWN_nameDef}’s original personality into dust—after traversing dozens of times through fields of death woven from blood and artillery fire, she was reforged into cold, unyielding iron.\n Yet, after repeatedly witnessing the deaths of comrades due to empty supply crates, fear has completely overrun reason. Now, she jumps at her own shadow.

AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.title: Gray Gene Clinic Doctor
AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.description: Before becoming a clinic doctor, {PAWN_nameDef} was a researcher at a renowned biotechnology institute. After the war, alien creatures were shipped to the facility crate after crate.\n The helpless cries of extraterrestrial species, treated like livestock, were merely metrics confirming their vitality.\n So she left that place and swore never to return. Hearing that the Advance Team might encounter wild alien species on frontier planets, she boarded one of the first ships as if seeking redemption.

AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.title: Gray Quartermaster
AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.description: Once hailed as the guardian angel of soldiers, {PAWN_nameDef} was the finest quartermaster on Sol III Station. She turned numbers and data into the Empire's lifeblood, pumping it to the most distant front lines. Then one day she discovered that most of the supplies she had carefully planned had been embezzled by her superiors, and soldiers were dying for lack of medicine and food. She reported it—and was exiled to the Advance Team, becoming a nameless pioneer. The angel was imprisoned on the ground forever after.

AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.title: Gray Adjutant
AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.description: {PAWN_nameDef} once served as the adjutant to the commander of the Empire's First Expeditionary Fleet flagship, Queen Elizabeth. She was trusted for calculating shell impact points faster than the shipboard computer. Then, on an expedition, she encountered the Correction Protocol. She and the commander fought with the fleet, but were ultimately defeated. At the last moment the fleet escaped through a wormhole, yet {PAWN_nameDef} failed to get out with them. Her last sighting remains at the very edge of the Empire's frontier sectors.

AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.title: Gray Artist
AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.description: {PAWN_nameDef} is an independent artist who owns an orbital art gallery station. She shapes sculptures with custom upgrade tools, or paints one-of-a-kind works with expensive, rare pigments. To her, the process of turning inspiration into reality is incomparably beautiful—but once a work is finished, it becomes dull again. The gallery always draws countless 'upper-class' visitors to admire her works, yet she never looks at the finished pieces. After exhausting all her inspiration, she abandoned everything she had and cast herself into the void, simply to expand the boundaries of art.

AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.title: Gray Research Supervisor
AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.description: {PAWN_nameDef} was the research supervisor of a laboratory on a science planet, leading the development of new weapons. She liked to test weapon power with her own body—numb limbs, convulsing reactions, the pain of experiencing her own creations firsthand made her feel alive. Yet this twisted habit made her controversial; apart from work, almost no one interacted with her. She had tested the power of her creations on herself countless times. This time, the creation finally answered. During an experiment in spatial technology, she was drawn into an unknown space and vanished without a trace.

AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.title: Gray Megastructure Engineer
AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.description: After years of rigorous study, {PAWN_nameDef} finally joined the Empire's megastructure engineering team. However, her first megaproject failed due to a major error. As punishment, she was permanently exiled to the Advance Team and forbidden from returning to the core sectors—the place of her dreams, now a distant home she can never return to.

AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.title: Gray Penal Colony Enforcer
AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.description: {PAWN_nameDef} was an elite captain in the defense department of a fortress world, famed for her marksmanship. Then, during one operation, she witnessed the truth of the destitution among the people in her jurisdiction. After speaking out several times and being suppressed for it, she was demoted to a remote penal world as a grassroots law officer. When the Gray Advance Team passed through that sector, she boarded without hesitation to escape ongoing political persecution and seek a new beginning.

AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.title: Gray Diplomat
AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.description: {PAWN_nameDef} once represented the Star Sea Empire as a diplomat in the Star Sea Community. The feast of carving up hostile nations does not end with a war victory; deception, coercion, intimidation—every method is used until the Empire has squeezed out every last benefit, and she herself has licked clean every last scrap. Only then does the banquet end. But this greed was eventually noticed. Sunken in luxury, she was finally exposed by the inspectors and thrown into the Advance Team as punishment, never to return to her former feast.

AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.title: Gray Maid
AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.description: For {PAWN_nameDef}, whose homeland was occupied, the nostalgic smell of cooking smoke stirs more homesickness than the all-encompassing smell of gunpowder. The great house where she lived for so many years, the fresh, well-cleaned air—all seem to have become things of the past. Now she has volunteered for the Advance Team to reclaim the landscapes in her memory that have not yet been tainted by gunpowder smoke. Even if the road ahead is full of blood and sacrifice, she will chase that scent that has long since faded from the years.

AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.title: Gray Geologist
AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.description: {PAWN_nameDef} believes stones should not be preserved and displayed as ancient relics, but rather the lingering fragrance left behind by past ages. Exploring unknown mines and wondrous geological formations in person—like softening meat before eating it, or ripening fruit before tasting it—is an essential part of research. For {PAWN_nameDef}, a doctor of geology, this communion with the earth is as natural as eating. That is why she joined the Advance Team.

AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.title: Gray Star Picker
AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.description: {PAWN_nameDef} was a technician at a stellar matter collection facility, spending day and night with the stars, turning starlight into the driving force of the Empire. But the power of the stars must eventually run out. Like Kuafu in myth, she pursued ever more brilliant starlight. To that end, she came to the rimworld—a new, untouched star sector.

AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.title: Gray Public Servants
AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.description: {PAWN_nameDef} was once a successful mayor, carefully managing an industrial planet-city of ten million people. She was the city's undisputed ruler, yet she was more fascinated by running and optimizing the entire city as a precision instrument. To her, power was tasteless; only the process of development and construction held any charm. In the end, she calmly handed over her authority and turned to the stars, to draw her next grand city blueprint.

AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.title: Gray Geisha
AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.description: {PAWN_nameDef} is a very special existence. Perhaps she was injected with a corrupted data stream while growing, or perhaps her core memory had long since strayed from its proper course. She ultimately chose to become a geisha, dedicating herself entirely to 'art'. Every customer who has had deep dealings with her praises her exquisite 'technique' and claims to have glimpsed perfection in her.

AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.title: Gray Wanderer doctor
AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.description: {PAWN_nameDef} is a professional surgeon with extensive emergency and surgical experience. After modification and upgrades, she can deploy a small operating table anywhere for field treatment or surgery. She never talks about where she came from or why she set out; she simply took to wandering the world, healing people along the way. Though she is always delayed on the road, she always smiles and does her part. She often says people should live in the present—say what you mean, and do what you wish. After all, only she knows that when everything is done, she can always slip away on a new journey late at night, when all is silent.

AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.title: Gray Storm Emperor
AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.description: With the fire of violence, hunt across dust and sky. {PAWN_nameDef} is an independent combat mech pilot, but to her, it is less 'piloting' than fighting with extended limbs. Thanks to special body modifications, the often-expensive equipment maintenance can usually be completed in a short time by the nanite swarm responsible for repairs, so she can maintain the entire mech alone without professional equipment. 'Compared to high-precision energy weapons, I personally prefer live ammunition with fierce firepower—or rather, explosive weapons! Pair that with thick heavy armor, and it's perfect.'
